resources.string: Accepts the six-digit pairing code without leaving the current screen.
Open Developer options - Wireless debugging - Pair device with pairing code. Keep that dialog open, pull down the notification shade and enter the six-digit code.
Device found, enter the six-digit code
No code received. Tap to enter it again
Pairing service not found: the pairing dialog may have been closed and that code expired. Reopen “Pair device with pairing code” in Settings, then enter the new code
